notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Dragons and/or Spirits.
You control a modified creature that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare any modified creature you control as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Goro-Goro by paying {5}, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token.
The Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {5}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may use Goro-Goro's first ability to give them haste.
